0022600028.text: Dallas hosts Utah in Emirates NBA Cup West Group A play, the Mavericks' ninth game of the season. Dallas is 4-4 (2-2 at home and 2-2 on the road) on a two-game losing streak, sitting 5th in the Southwest, 2.5 games back, and 11th in the West, while Utah is 1-7 on a six-game losing streak, 5th in the Northwest and 14th in the West. Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), and Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Santi Aldama (knee, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), with Kyrie Irving (illness) and Max Christie (hip) listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, with no games yet this season, and the Mavericks won the last meeting 138-120 in Dallas on January 17, 2026.
